name: quantum-ads-mcp
description: Google marketing control plane: Google Ads v26 and 24 more Google APIs, guarded writes, signed audit.
long_description: Read and change Google Ads, GA4, Tag Manager, Merchant, YouTube, DV360, CM360, SA360, Business Profile, Search Console, BigQuery and more. Every write is previewed (validate_only or the API contract), guarded by read-only mode and an optional policy, and recorded in an Ed25519-signed, hash-chained audit with rollback.

developer_token.title: Google Ads developer token
developer_token.description: From the Google Ads API Center of your manager account.

client_id.title: OAuth client id
client_id.description: Desktop OAuth client from your Google Cloud project.

client_secret.title: OAuth client secret
client_secret.description: Secret of the same OAuth client.

refresh_token.title: OAuth refresh token
refresh_token.description: Minted with scripts/get_refresh_token.py; carries the scopes of the connectors you use.

cloud_project.title: Google Cloud project (optional)
cloud_project.description: Enables BigQuery, Vertex, Language and reCAPTCHA, and routes quota.

read_only.title: Read-only mode
read_only.description: true refuses every write; false enables guarded writes (preview, audit, rollback).
